scope: Publication code integration checks; historical analysis completion is recorded separately.

complete_imported_test_suite.execution_directory: An unrelated temporary directory outside the repository.

dependency_import_check.side_effect_scope: Imports performed in a separate process with bytecode writing disabled; no historical runner was called.

expected_non_prose_function_changes.reason: Resolve a source-manifest raw-relative member below the configured data root; reject ambiguous or escaping paths and verify the original checksum.
Read original frozen protocol and model_options provenance through the configured external source root.

scientific_function_structure_check.comparison_scope: AST comparison ignores string constants, docstrings, and translated display-column keyword labels. It checks numerical/control-flow structure, not semantic equivalence of every string-valued key; focused tests and source review complement this limited check.
scientific_function_structure_check.top_level_changes: Package-qualified imports, private dependency loading, configurable path roots, and display text; these are outside the function-structure comparison.

published_input_access_check.raw_preprocessing_claim: Access and byte identity only; this does not repair the original full-condition/full-time imputation limitation.

legacy_global_config_scope.current_protocol: The retained final analysis uses the saved 100 condition splits and FA50/GPFA50 settings.

full_reproduction.limits: The retained full scientific write routes require materialized external dependencies, an isolated writable output workspace, and new execution records. Their end-to-end portability was not exercised or claimed during this integration.

record_scope: Historical portability checks for the original integration source edition; saved numerical outcomes and failures are retained.
